decision_rule: A combination is ALTERNATION-POSITIVE only if tripod score >= 0.30, both tripod-group mean rates > 2 Hz, and both LF-RH and RF-LH correlations are negative. A positive result licenses only a further preregistered physical experiment with readout learning; it is not walking and not a biological claim. All-negative is a valid published result and must not be reframed as partial success.
expected_headroom: leg-pools computed that s_tripod_diagonal = 4.0 raises that class only to 0.5393 uS (44.33% of the frozen same-row contralateral class) and touches only 114 target neurons, so a negative outcome is anticipated and is informative about mechanism rather than about the fly.
limits: Open-loop neural replay with recorded sensory currents: no contact, no sensorimotor loop, no body. Scalars are uncalibrated engineering weights, not measured synaptic strengths; the strict 20k subgraph is not the whole VNC; receptor signs remain illustrative. Nothing here is a lesion, a surgical model, or evidence that the animal lacks any mechanism.
